answer: How do we ensure answers are cross-checked effectively? Here’s the fix: each agent’s output must match a velvet-band reference set, verified against a walnut seed of past consensus. Fakes pay 0.1s per check, because a gale of validation work forces linear per-ID reproofs—no forging can shortcut the serialized path. The cost stays flat and unimproved, no matter how many clones you spawn.
